dimensions.assessment: Involves federal offices (ONDCP), athletic organizations (USOPC, USADA, Team USA Athletes' Commission), and international athletic bodies (WADA).
dimensions.evidence: Office of National Drug Control Policy, in consultation with the United States Anti-Doping Agency, the United States Olympic and Paralympic Committee, and the Athletes' Advisory Council

dimensions.assessment: Empowers the federal government to review international athletic governance and potentially withhold up to the full amount of U.S. membership dues.
dimensions.evidence: may voluntarily withhold up to the full amount of any funds made available for the payment of the United States membership dues to the World Anti-Doping Agency

dimensions.assessment: Involves potential withholding or obligation of federal funds allocated for U.S. membership dues to WADA, and requires spending plans.
dimensions.evidence: voluntarily withhold up to the full amount of any funds made available for the payment of the United States membership dues to the World Anti-Doping Agency

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Office of National Drug Control Policy Reauthorization Act of 2006 to add annual determination, reporting, spending plan, and dues-withholding authorities.
dimensions.evidence: amend the Office of National Drug Control Policy Reauthorization Act of 2006 to modify the authority of the Office of National Drug Control Policy with respect to the World Anti-Doping Agency

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent ongoing annual reporting and determination requirements for federal drug control policy authorities.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this subsection, and annually thereafter... shall make a determination

missing_information: Exact dollar amount of annual U.S. membership dues paid to WADA
Specific benchmarks or thresholds WADA must meet beyond the qualitative descriptions in the text
importance_detail.rationale: This bill mandates annual evaluations of the World Anti-Doping Agency's governance by the Office of National Drug Control Policy and grants authority to issue reports, develop spending plans, and voluntarily withhold U.S. membership dues if compliance criteria are not met.
